description: This is a test class for the ForceLocaleList functionality in the AnySoftKeyboard project, verifying the validity of locale configurations in various add-ons and settings.

classes.name: ForceLocaleListTest
classes.description: Test class for validating locale configurations in the application.

methods.name: testAllLocaleInForceLocalesListAreValid
methods.description: Verifies that all locales in the force locale list are valid Locale objects.

methods.name: testNoForceLocaleCrashes
methods.description: Ensures that getting Locale objects from force locale strings does not cause crashes.

methods.name: testAllLocalesInKeyboardAddOnsAreValid
methods.description: Checks that all keyboard add-ons have valid locale tags, unless empty.

methods.name: testAllLocalesInDictionaryAddOnsAreValid
methods.description: Checks that all dictionary add-ons have valid locale tags.
